title: advertiser.v1
description: One advertiser cluster: ads linked by a shared identifying key (phone last-4, social handle, name, title, description prefix, written venue). DERIVED (derived/advertisers.jsonl), rebuilt by `llens derive-advertisers` from the latest listings; it holds no fact of its own. `venue_only`: linked only through a shared written venue, so NOT an advertiser for a panel.

advertiser_id.description: sha256 of the sorted member ad_ids; a new member gives a new id (a panel keeps its own member list). The prefix names the method: adv- = advertisers@1 (frozen), v1.1: = advertisers@1.1 (the default since 2026-11-08).

link_kinds.description: Key kinds that at least two of the cluster's ads share.
